title: Christmas in the Park
seo_title: Christmas in the Park at Boswell Park in Lebanon, MO
description: Christmas in the Park is a free holiday evening with hot chocolate, hay rides, inflatables, Santa photos, live choir performances, hot dogs, and food trucks. The first 200 kids also get a special mystery squishy dumpling, and the event is presented by the Lebanon Parks Department. It takes place Friday, December 4, 2026, from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM at Boswell Park on Drury Lane in Lebanon, MO.
